messages:
ida: Quick follow-up from pairing: proposing a hybrid approach that combines slab-lease tokens with a lightweight epoch reclaim to avoid hot-path stalls and reduce fragmentation. Short notes + sketch.

ryan: Summary pls?

ida: Two levers: (1) slab-lease token covering contiguous slab to avoid per-page churn; (2) request epochs to provide a non-blocking quiesce point for reclaim. Lease reduces metadata, epoch avoids global pauses.

tomo: How do they interact during prefetch/commit?

ida: Prefetch acquires slab-lease -> writes into a per-request staging list tagged with request_epoch. Commit is atomic: swap pointer from old slab to new staging pointer. Evictor advances epoch periodically and only reclaims slabs with last_seen_epoch < current_epoch - grace. If evictor needs leased slab, it negotiates: short wait -> cancel if lease-holder unresponsive.

ryan: Negotiation proto? Keep it simple.

tomo: Sketch: try_acquire_lease(slab) || open_negotiation(slab, evictor_id). Negotiation waits backoff_ms; if no release, evictor can mark pressure and preempt following heartbeat failure. Heartbeat required while holding long staging writes.

ida: Cancellation semantics: staging abandoned => no publish, GC by epoch. Publishing must be all-or-nothing per-request to avoid partial kvcache writes.

ryan: Telemetry required: slab_lease_waits, negotiation_backoffs, staging_abandon_rate, epoch_reclaim_batches.

infra-bot: Created ticket ALLOC-9009: "hybrid slab-lease + epoch reclaim" and scheduled canary.

ida: Rollout plan: feature-flagged prototype -> metrics-only run -> canary with conservative defaults (slab_size=2MB, epoch_tick=30ms, grace=2) -> iterate.

ryan: Tests: contention sim with N workers, cancel racecases, partial-staging-abandon leak check. Also perf: cold-token p99 and memory overhead.

ida: Decision: proceed with prototype behind feature flag. I'll open WIP branch and link.
